content_sections.text: Candidates who wish to apply for DLSA Satara Para Legal Volunteers (PLV) Recruitment 2026 through offline mode should follow the steps below. Read the official notification carefully before applying. Download the application form from the official website: https://satara.dcourts.gov.in/ Fill the application form carefully with correct information. Attach self-attested copies of required documents such as photograph, signature, ID proof, and certificates. Check all details carefully before submission. Send the completed application form to the address mentioned in the notification through Speed Post / Registered Post or as instructed. Ensure the application reaches before the last date: 03-10-2026. Keep a photocopy of the submitted application form for future reference.

faq.question: Q1. What is the organization conducting this recruitment?
faq.answer: The recruitment is conducted by the District Legal Services Authority Satara, Maharashtra, to fill Para Legal Volunteers positions on a contract basis under the guidance of NALSA guidelines.

faq.question: Q2. What is the last date to submit the application form?
faq.answer: The last date for submitting the filled offline application form is 03 October 2026 up to 6:00 PM. Candidates must ensure their applications reach the designated office before this deadline.

faq.question: Q3. What is the mode of application for DLSA Satara PLV recruitment?
faq.answer: The application mode is strictly offline. Interested candidates must download the form, fill it out completely, attach required self-attested documents, and send it by post or hand delivery.

faq.question: Q4. Who is eligible to apply for the Para Legal Volunteers post?
faq.answer: Eligible candidates include retired teachers or government employees, social work or law students, Anganwadi workers, members of grassroots organizations, and literate women from self-help groups.

faq.question: Q5. What is the minimum age required to apply?
faq.answer: The minimum age required to apply for the Para Legal Volunteers position is 18 years. There is no specific maximum age limit mentioned in the official notification.

faq.question: Q6. Is there any application fee for this recruitment?
faq.answer: No application fee is required to be paid by candidates applying for the DLSA Satara Para Legal Volunteers recruitment as per the official notification details.

faq.question: Q7. How will candidates be selected for the PLV posts?
faq.answer: The selection process includes screening of the received offline applications, followed by a personal interview and mandatory training sessions conducted by the authority.

faq.question: Q8. Where can I download the application form?
faq.answer: Candidates can download the application form directly from the official website www.nalsa.gov.in or obtain it from the District Legal Services Authority, Satara office.

faq.question: Q9. What is the salary or honorarium provided for PLVs?
faq.answer: Selected candidates will receive an honorarium as decided by NALSA and the Maharashtra State Legal Services Authority from time to time on a regular service basis.

faq.question: Q10. What documents need to be attached with the offline form?
faq.answer: Candidates need to attach self-attested copies of educational qualification certificates, age proof, identity proof, and relevant experience documents along with the filled application form.
